items.back: Adopted 10 Dec 1948 (Human Rights Day); non-binding. Binding covenants ICCPR & ICESCR (1966), India ratified 1979.
items.examPoint: UDHR (1948) reflected in Preamble, DPSP & Fundamental Duties

items.back: Protection of Human Rights Act 1993; statutory & recommendatory; 2019 amd: SC judge (not only ex-CJI) can chair, term 5→3 yrs; limited role over armed forces.
Art 17 abolishes untouchability (Right to Equality); enforced by Protection of Civil Rights Act 1955 & SC/ST (PoA) Act 1989.
Art 21; privacy affirmed in Puttaswamy (2017, 9-judge); also right to marry of choice, dignity, clean environment.
44th Amendment 1978 removed it as a FR; now a legal/constitutional right under Art 300A, available to any person.
items.examPoint: Right to Property — Art 300A (44th Amendment 1978), a legal right

items.back: Fifth = Scheduled Areas/STs in 10 States; restricts tribal-land transfer to non-tribals; Governor + Tribes Advisory Council. Sixth = autonomous councils in Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram.
items.examPoint: Fifth Schedule — restricts transfer of tribal land to non-tribals

items.back: Art 21A (86th Amendment 2002) — free education ages 6-14; RTE Act 2009 (force 1 Apr 2010); 25% EWS seats in private unaided schools.
POSH Act 2013 codified Vishaka (1997), ICC in 10+ workplaces; Criminal Law (Amdt) Act 2013 (Nirbhaya, Justice Verma); Maternity leave 12→26 weeks (2017).
POCSO 2012 (gender-neutral, under-18); JJ Act 2015 (16-18 tried as adults for heinous); NCPCR under CPCR Act 2005; Child Labour Amdt 2016 (no work below 14).
items.examPoint: Child rights — POCSO, JJ Act, NCPCR

items.back: Replaced 1995 Act; disabilities 7→21; 4% job & 5% higher-education reservation; implements UNCRPD (ratified 2007).
NCSC (338), NCST (338A) split by 89th Amdt 2003; NCBC (338B) 102nd Amdt 2018. PoA 2018 amendment (Sec 18A) restored bar on anticipatory bail after Subhash Kashinath Mahajan.
A 7-judge Supreme Court bench held States CAN sub-classify SCs for reservation, overruling E.V. Chinnaiah (2004).
